name: Colombia excluding Panama
definition: Retrospective CELADE estimate. The table has a separate Panama row and Federico and Tena-Junguito expressly exclude Panama from the Colombia series. The report gives no day and no population breakdown for frontier or offshore areas.
method: published retrospective estimate in thousands converted to persons

name: Panama, separately estimated Colombian component
definition: Retrospective CELADE estimate for Panama on its own tabular line. Panama was part of Colombia in 1900. The report gives no day and no separate figures for the western frontier, islands or the future Canal Zone.
method: published retrospective estimate in thousands converted to persons
